x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / (2a). The fraction line is under the whole numerator.
If A × B = 0 then A = 0 or B = 0. This is only true when the product equals zero.
x² − 7x = 0, x(x − 7) = 0, so x = 0 or x = 7. Never divide by x: you lose x = 0.
Take a out of the x² and x terms first: 2x² − 12x + 7 = 2[(x − 3)² − 9] + 7 = 2(x − 3)² − 11.
